entities.name: Henri-François Rey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri-François Rey was a French writer, dramaturge and screenwriter. His book La Fête espagnole won the 1959 Prix des Deux Magots. His best-known work, Les Pianos mécaniques won the Interallié prize in 1962, and was adapted to film by Juan Antonio Bardem in 1965 as The Uninhibited.
